_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin' section. Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet.
fetch_method: klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (2AMLogic/klayout-tools), same fetch this repo's design/README.md documents for schematic-entry work
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

documented_tool_versions_from_pdk_versio.note: This PDK release's own versions.txt names openvaf 23.5.0 as the tool used to build its Verilog-A device models to OSDI. That upstream release ships source only (no binary assets), so this repo builds the same models with the PDK-preferred OpenVAF-Reloaded fork instead -- see osdi_toolchain below and sim/README.md 'OSDI device models'.

osdi_toolchain._comment: Provenance of the OSDI (Verilog-A compact model) binaries every MOS/resistor-instantiating testbench in this tree loads. sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is the executable source of truth; this block restates its pins as a greppable fact sheet, per this file's convention. Nothing under sim/ commits a .osdi binary: they are platform-specific shared libraries, rebuilt locally from the PDK's own Verilog-A sources.
osdi_toolchain.approach: source-compile the PDK's own Verilog-A models with a checksum-pinned prebuilt OpenVAF-Reloaded compiler
osdi_toolchain.asset_sha256_source: GitHub release API digest field for the v24.0.1mob release, re-checked 2026-08-21
osdi_toolchain.platform_actually_exercised: macos-aarch64 (Darwin 26.6 / arm64) and, as of issue #14, linux-x86_64 (Ubuntu 24.04/noble) -- the windows pin is upstream-attested but not yet executed in this repo. linux-x86_64 needed a workaround `sim/tools/build-osdi.sh` does not yet apply automatically: the pinned openvaf-r-v24.0.1mob-linux-x86_64 release ships lib/libLLVM.so.21.1 as a dangling symlink to ../../x86_64-linux-gnu/libLLVM.so.21.1 -- it assumes the HOST provides a system-installed LLVM 21, which stock Ubuntu 24.04 does not (max system package is libllvm20). Verified working fix: LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointed at the real libLLVM.so.21.1 extracted (dpkg-deb -x, no root needed) from apt.llvm.org's libllvm21 .deb for noble (sha256 f1f058fff19f9d711c32b9efe5cd473dd2f0e7d5338d082fa5a25858322048cd as of 2026-08-21) -- see https://github.com/2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap/issues/31 for the tracked fix to build-osdi.sh itself.
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo)
osdi_toolchain.compile_command: openvaf-r -D__NGSPICE__ -o <install_dir>/<model>.osdi <model>.va, run from PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/verilog-a/<model_dir> -- the same flags and model list as the PDK's own libs.tech/verilog-a/openvaf-compile-va.sh
osdi_toolchain.ngspice_actually_used: ngspice-47 (homebrew), which has OSDI support compiled in; the PDK's versions.txt documents ngspice 43
